title: Comment "Fable" and I'll send you the full guide 👇 Claude just dropped the most powerful AI model
description: Comment "Fable" and I'll send you the full guide 👇 Claude just dropped the most powerful AI model on the planet and this thing is genuinely insane. It's called Fable 5 and it's a Mythos Class Model—the exact same one they gave the government and said was too powerful to release publicly. They added safeguards and released it anyway. Fable 5 crushes every other model on the benchmarks. People are already building crazy things with it: • One guy remade Mario Kart 64 with just two sentences • Stripe gave it a task that would've taken months and it solved it in one day You can access it right now. Just go to Claude, open the model selector, and you'll see Fable 5. I told it to build me a 3D website for a random business and the result was insane. All from one prompt. The catch? This model burns through your tokens and is overkill for most tasks. Unless you're building something super complicated, stick with the older models. #ai #claude #fable #aitools #claudecode
